mapper.select: select * from admin where ADMIN_ID = #{admin_id} and ADMIN_PW = #{admin_pw}
mapper.insert: insert into notice ( NOTICE_INDEX, NOTICE_TITLE, NOTICE_CON, NOTICE_DATE) values( notice_NUM_SEQ.nextval, #{notice_title}, #{notice_con}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: select NOTICE_INDEX, NOTICE_TITLE, NOTICE_CON, NOTICE_DATE from notice ORDER BY NOTICE_DATE DESC
SELECT INQUIRY_INDEX, INQUIRY_TITLE, MEM_ID, INQUIRY_DATE, INQUIRY_COMMENT FROM INQUIRY ORDER BY INQUIRY_INDEX DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE INQUIRY SET INQUIRY_COMMENT = #{inquiry_comment}, INQUIRY_COMMENT_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE INQUIRY_INDEX = #{inquiry_index}
mapper.select: SELECT INQUIRY_INDEX, INQUIRY_TITLE, MEM_ID, INQUIRY_CON, INQUIRY_DATE, INQUIRY_ISPUBLIC, INQUIRY_COMMENT_DATE, INQUIRY_COMMENT FROM INQUIRY WHERE INQUIRY_INDEX = #{inquiryIndex}
SELECT INQUIRY_INDEX, INQUIRY_TITLE, MEM_ID, INQUIRY_DATE, INQUIRY_COMMENT FROM INQUIRY WHERE INQUIRY_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{value} || '%' ORDER BY INQUIRY_INDEX DESC
